links.outcome: LLM Engel/ILAE score agreement against human-adjudicated consensus reference standard, by prompt configuration
links.effect: Definition-based prompt: 56.5% exact Engel and 60.6% exact ILAE agreement; context-aware prompt: 94.7% Engel and 93.5% ILAE (paired sign tests p < .001).
links.quote: The context-aware prompt improved exact agreement to 94.7% for Engel (95% CI = 90.2-97.2) and 93.5% for ILAE (95% CI = 88.8-96.3), with lower ordinal distance for both scales (paired sign tests p < .001).

unlisted_practices: Context-aware prompt design incorporating temporal, causal, and adherence logic to improve LLM extraction accuracy

links.outcome: Exact agreement with adjudicated outcome scores
links.effect: Definition-based prompt: 56.5% Engel subclass and 60.6% ILAE exact agreement.
links.quote: The definition-based prompt achieved 56.5% exact Engel subclass agreement (95% CI = 49.0-63.7) and 60.6% exact ILAE agreement (95% CI = 53.1-67.6).

unlisted_practices: Use context-aware LLM prompts incorporating temporal, causal, and adherence logic for automated seizure-outcome scoring.
